meta.source: Extracted from two reference shots of a radial quick-access dial (dark ring, white knob) and the CMF Buds Pro 2 Smart Dial.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The desktop ground behind the dial in previews and settings. Never used inside the dial.

tokens.name: canvas-raised
tokens.usage: Settings window panels and preview stages that sit on canvas.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The C-shaped ring body. Stays dark in both themes: the ring is an object, not a surface.

tokens.name: ring-well
tokens.usage: The recessed well between the ring and the knob. Darker than ring in dark, near-white in light, so the knob always reads as raised.

tokens.name: ring-divider
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between ring segments. Decorative, no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: segment-active
tokens.usage: The lifted, highlighted segment. Pairs with icon-active (8.5:1 dark, 6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: segment-hatch
tokens.usage: 45° stripes laid over segment-active. Texture only.

tokens.name: icon-idle
tokens.usage: Resting segment icons on ring (5.3:1 dark, 5.5:1 light).

tokens.name: icon-active
tokens.usage: The icon on segment-active.

tokens.name: knob-face
tokens.usage: Knob face highlight, the top-left of its radial gradient.

tokens.name: knob-shade
tokens.usage: Knob face shadow side and the inner rim line.

tokens.name: knob-knurl
tokens.usage: The knurled outer band of the knob; its teeth are knob-face lines on top.

tokens.name: knob-ink
tokens.usage: Pointer marks, icon and label on the knob face (11.7:1 on knob-face).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The warm rim light on the knob and the press pulse. Never text, never a fill larger than the knob.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus rings (6.8:1 dark, 3.7:1 light against canvas).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, card and menubar.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and values on canvas and card (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Mode HUD pill, app cards, control chips.

tokens.name: card-active
tokens.usage: The selected card in the app fan and hovered chips.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on cards and chips.

tokens.name: card-border-active
tokens.usage: Border of the selected card, and the connector line to it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Meter tracks and dividers in the HUD and settings.

tokens.name: menubar
tokens.usage: The mock macOS menu bar in previews.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: knob-label
styles.usage: The mode name on the knob face. One short word.

styles.name: hud-label
styles.usage: Mode name in the HUD pill and the menu bar item.

styles.name: hud-value
styles.usage: Numbers and positions in the HUD: 62, 3 / 8.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: App names in the app fan, window titles in Mission Control.

styles.name: card-meta
styles.usage: Shortcut hints and counts beside a card title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Switch on what the wheel shows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside the knob.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside the HUD pill and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between fan cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between the menu bar and the dial's top edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Settings panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the dial and the settings list.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Control chips, keyboard hints, the lifted segment's corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: App cards and window thumbnails; the ring's end caps at the gap.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Settings panels and preview stages.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The HUD pill and the menu bar mode item.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Under the whole dial: it floats below the menu bar.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Knob at rest. On press it tightens to shadow-knob-pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-knob-pressed
tokens.usage: Knob held down.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: HUD pill and app cards.

geometry.note: The dial is drawn on a 260px square, centre 130,130. Angles run clockwise from 12 o'clock.

tokens.name: ring-radius-outer
tokens.usage: Outer edge of the ring.

tokens.name: ring-radius-inner
tokens.usage: Inner edge of the ring; the well starts 6px inside it.

tokens.name: ring-gap
tokens.usage: Opening at the top, centred on 12 o'clock. It faces the menu bar item the dial drops from.

tokens.name: segment-lift
tokens.usage: How far the active segment rises past the ring's outer edge.

tokens.name: knob-radius
tokens.usage: Knob including its knurled band (4px).

tokens.name: knob-detent
tokens.usage: How far the knob face turns per detent inside a mode.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Segment icons, centred on a 90px radius.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke for every icon on a 24px grid.

timing.note: Motion lives in tokens.css as --dur-* and --ease-*; the full choreography is in the Motion section.

tokens.name: dur-detent
tokens.usage: One step of the highlight and the knob.

tokens.name: dur-detent-fast
tokens.usage: Steps that arrive under 70ms apart: a fast spin.

tokens.name: dur-press-down
tokens.usage: Knob sinking on press.

tokens.name: dur-press-up
tokens.usage: Knob springing back.

tokens.name: dur-summon
tokens.usage: Dial dropping out of the menu bar.

tokens.name: dur-dismiss
tokens.usage: Dial pulling back into the menu bar.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between segment icons on summon, clockwise.

tokens.name: dur-hud
tokens.usage: HUD pill in and out.

tokens.name: hud-linger
tokens.usage: How long the HUD stays after the last turn.

tokens.name: idle-dismiss
tokens.usage: The dial closes itself after this long without input.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: summon, HUD in.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: dismiss, press-down.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Knob release, icon tick, fan cards: a small overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-detent
tokens.usage: Highlight and knob steps: lands with a click-like settle.
